purpose: Time-aware competitive intelligence for candidate niche-first marketing; not a product ranking.

fieldSemantics.firstReleasedAt: First public release date of product (unknown unless individually researched); NOT a claim of first feature.
fieldSemantics.latestStableAt: Publication date of independently confirmed stable release; null if not confirmed.
fieldSemantics.latestPreviewAt: Publication date of independently confirmed beta/pre-release; never silently promote to stable.
fieldSemantics.lastSourceActivityAt: GitHub pushed_at from repository API (UTC); not release date or evidence of feature readiness.
fieldSemantics.lastStoreUpdatedAt: Independent browser-store timestamp; not filled from GitHub release or source activity.
fieldSemantics.lastVerifiedAt: Date of checking referenced sources; evidence can expire.
fieldSemantics.maintenanceAssessment: ACTIVE_SOURCE / ACTIVE_RELEASE / SLOW_RELEASE_CYCLE / UNKNOWN; not a conclusion that a project is dead.
fieldSemantics.maintenanceState: R2 normalized six-way signal: RELEASE_ACTIVE, SOURCE_ACTIVE, SLOW_MAINTENANCE, HISTORICAL, DEPRECATED, UNKNOWN. Separate from legacy maintenanceAssessment.
fieldSemantics.r2Evidence: Per-field observed date, channel and source link; record never implies all competing products were installed or benchmarked.

reviewRules.after180DaysWithoutKnownStableRelease: FOLLOWUP_VERIFY—check store, docs, beta, and product activity; do not assume abandoned.
reviewRules.after365DaysWithoutEvidence: PRIORITY_REVIEW—still do not mark DEAD without authoritative evidence.
reviewRules.comparisonsMustCheck: same browser, channel (stable/beta), published package, functionality, permission, and reproducible task
reviewRules.recheckCadence: monthly for core rivals; within 7 days before marketing launch; immediately when disproving counterexample appears
reviewRules.r2MarketingGate: Never use a global first/fastest claim when current version and equivalent competing workflow have not been verified.
